task: Check whether a rejected member admission rolls back all of its equality contributions.
observation: The standalone C++ probe received UnificationFailed after contradictory contributions, but the first successful equality remained applied and T resolved to int. Production checker callers throw immediately on closure failure, so the solver is not reused in those paths.
impact: There is no demonstrated user-visible inference error, but the reusable admission API exposed partially committed state despite a rejected admission, unlike one atomic TypeSolver::unify operation.
evidence: src/moss.cpp:8920 checker rejects UnificationFailed through err()

resolution.summary: close_member_requirements now applies all contributed and result equalities in one TypeSolver transaction; focused rollback and success cases pass.
